note: Re-judged 2026-10-14 (independent auditor, D2). RFC 8092 Section 3: "Duplicate BGP Large Community values MUST NOT be transmitted." Producer: normalizeTransmittedUpdate's compactLargeCommunities, run by writeUpdateBody on every UPDATE write, raw included, so the adj-rib-out replay and forward-unchanged bytes the earlier verdict named now pass the same walk. Positive TestRFC8092WriteRemovesRepeatedLargeCommunity: [X,X,Y] sent as [X,Y], 20 values with one repeat (filter path) and 22 in Extended Length form sent with the repeat removed, first occurrence kept, lengths re-checked by sentLargeCommunities, on the raw, parsed, override and relay writers, zero allocations; TestRFC8092PolicyAddOfPresentValueSentOnce: received [X,Z] plus a policy body [X,Z,X,Y,Y] leaves as exactly [X,Z,Y], 36 octets, message length consistent; the .ci asserts the full relayed hex with the policy repeats gone; TestLargeCommunitiesWriteToNoDuplicates pins the local encoder. Negatives TestRFC8092WriteKeepsDistinctLargeCommunities (3, 16, 17, 20 distinct values leave byte for byte on every writer) and TestLargeCommunities, red on over-removal or reordering. Rejudged 2026-10-16 (independent reader) after the owner-approved withdrawal-Compatibility change: normalizeTransmittedUpdate gained an EncodingContext parameter read only by setWithdrawalCompatibility on an MP_UNREACH_NLRI. The edits in TestRFC8092WriteRemovesRepeatedLargeCommunity and TestRFC8092WriteKeepsDistinctLargeCommunities pass nil; their bodies carry no MP_UNREACH_NLRI, so the context is never read and the Large Community compaction and its exact-output assertions are unchanged. RFC 8092 Section 3: "Duplicate BGP Large Community values MUST NOT be transmitted." Verdict stands.
